name: Cream of Oysters
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: oysters in their own liquor
ingredients.originalText: One quart of oysters in their own liquor

ingredients.name: Pepper, salt and paprica to taste
ingredients.originalText: Pepper, salt and paprica to taste

ingredients.name: half pint of whipped cream
ingredients.originalText: One half pint of whipped cream

instructions.text: Scald a quart of oysters in their own liquor
Remove the oysters; chop and pound them in a mortar, then press as much of them as possible through a puree sieve
Make a roux of one tablespoonful of butter and a heaping tablespoonful of flour
Dilute it with the oyster juice
Add the oyster pulp; season it with pepper, salt and paprica, and keep it hot until ready to serve
Just before serving add a half pint of whipped cream, and beat it well into the soup

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Scald a quart of oysters in their own liquor
2. Remove the oysters; chop and pound them in a mortar, then press as much of them as possible through a puree sieve
3. Make a roux of one tablespoonful of butter and a heaping tablespoonful of flour
4. Dilute it with the oyster juice
5. Add the oyster pulp; season it with pepper, salt and paprica, and keep it hot until ready to serve
6. Just before serving add a half pint of whipped cream, and beat it well into the soup
